# Details

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use details to let users reveal optional supporting information without distracting from the main task.

## When to use

- Use for optional help or additional context that only some users need.
- Use when the summary alone clearly explains what will be revealed.

## When not to use

- Do not hide information most users need to understand or complete the task.
- Do not hide validation errors, eligibility conditions or important consequences.
- Do not use several details components when a clearer page structure would be easier to scan.

## Anatomy

- **Details element (required):** The native details element provides disclosure behaviour without GOV.UK JavaScript.
- **Summary (required):** A native summary contains a short, descriptive govuk-details__summary-text label.
- **Details text (required):** The revealed content sits in govuk-details__text.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Closed by default | `details` | `govuk-details` | Optional supporting content that is not required immediately. |
| Open by default | `details` | `govuk-details` | An exceptional case where the native open attribute is justified by the current context. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- Use the browser's native details and summary disclosure; no GOV.UK JavaScript module is required.
- Do not replace summary with a generic div or custom click handler.
- Content remains available in browsers that expose the native element without CSS.

## Accessibility contract

- Keep the native elements and visible focus treatment.
- Make the summary meaningful when read independently and avoid duplicate summaries on a page.
- Ensure revealed interactive content follows the summary in a logical keyboard order.

## Content rules

- Write the summary as a concise label for the hidden content, such as “Help with nationality”.
- Keep the revealed answer focused and move essential instructions into the main page content.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.link`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.color.focus-text`
- `govuk.color.text`

## HTML examples

### Optional help

```html
<details class="govuk-details">
  <summary class="govuk-details__summary">
    <span class="govuk-details__summary-text">Help with nationality</span>
  </summary>
  <div class="govuk-details__text">Tell us the nationality shown on your passport.</div>
</details>
```
